_ملاحظة: المعلّق التقني (ملحق ب-2): أسماء جداول SQL Server. انسخ إلى sql_queries.json واملأ الأسماء الحقيقية. مستخدم قراءة فقط (§11.4). {placeholders} تُملأ وقت الاستعلام.

queries.verify_transaction: SELECT TOP 1 {transaction_ref} AS ref FROM {transactions} WHERE {reference_number} = ? AND {amount} = ? AND {customer_code} = ? AND {operation_type} = ? ORDER BY {created_at} DESC
queries.last_pending: SELECT TOP 1 {transaction_ref} AS ref, {reference_number} AS refnum, {amount} AS amount FROM {transactions} WHERE {reference_number} = ? ORDER BY {created_at} DESC
queries.reconcile_transaction: SELECT TOP 1 {transaction_ref} AS ref, {customer_code} AS customer_code, {customer_name} AS customer_name, {amount} AS amount, {price} AS price, {commission} AS commission FROM {transactions} WHERE {reference_number} = ? ORDER BY {created_at} DESC
